current_criteria.rule: Choose a source-supported usable programme from net geometry while preserving n, necessary bedrooms and all services. Try genuine core/split/placement alternatives before reducing bedrooms. Approved one-bedroom/two-person and two-bedroom/four-person design scenarios are not actual population, solver feasibility, or automatic quality approval. Do not maximize bedroom count or let mean quality hide one poor unit.
required_data: Public request and exact n; per-unit net floor/wall/common/core accounting with conventions.
Programme ID/approval provenance, per-unit sleep roles and design capacity; actual fixture dimensions and distinct instances, clothes and activities.
Source-supported lower-bound/profile inventory; log absent prefilter bounds separately from impossible geometry.
AP07 attempted alternatives, unchanged programme constraints, budgets and explicit untried branches; reduction creates a new programme alternative, not fixed-programme repair.
Fresh placement/access/operation findings and calibrated room/unit quality-floor evidence; Pareto vectors with same references, no hidden weighted score.
missing_rule: Operational selection of required quality dimensions and reviewed acceptance-anchor criteria remains unresolved; the qualitative programme requirement itself exists.
missing_profile: Calibrated quality floors and reviewed scenario/equipment/activity profiles.
missing_evidence: Same-model full-bundle adequacy, AP07 comparative sequence, genuine net-capacity/prefilter and alternative-selection evidence.
known_rule_scope: No arbitrary score, weight or area cutoff may be invented.
current_criteria.conditional_pass: All necessary programme and bundle uses proven for each unit under qualified applicable profiles, fixed n and auditable alternative selection; quality floors and non-dominated selection supported. Not executable closure in current study.
fail_examples: Silently lower n or sleeping capacity to fit.
A required bedroom/service cannot be used under a valid known profile.
Average quality compensates for a proven failed unit.
current_criteria.catalog_checker_limit: INTERNAL_INSTANCE_CAPACITY is limited source-profile evidence; CURRENT_PROGRAM_SUITABILITY remains UNKNOWN. Registry approval is independent of readiness.
current_criteria.next_action: Read same-model dd3b assessment after baseline integrity audit, distinguish each open rule/profile/evidence and add scoped witness without copying old-model probes.

current_criteria.rule: Per unit verify four independent width-bearing routes: entry→living, entry→actual dining use destination, entry→WC, living↔dining. Required guest movement must avoid actual kitchen equipment, effective opening/motion and cooking/use areas in required scenarios. An enclosed kitchen or separate corridor is not mandated. Guest arrival should reach living without forced travel through dining occupation or cooking.
required_data: Unit and real entry/threshold IDs; actual living/dining/WC activity destinations bound to fixtures and source modules.
Current floor/walls/openings, cabinet bodies, effective door/drawer/fridge motions and cooking/workstation activity envelopes.
Scenario of door/chair states and simultaneous necessary uses; qualified profile and width, connected swept body routes, actual openings and bottleneck evidence.
WC private-domain exclusion; first-living ordering witness, graphical and geometric evidence from identical model hash.
missing_profile: Effective route/activity width, simultaneous-operation scenario and ergonomic support may be unqualified.
missing_evidence: All four actual destination routes, bottlenecks/openings, first-living and effective-state coverage on same model.
known_rule_scope: No requirement for a separate corridor or whole-kitchen-floor prohibition; do not invent these.
current_criteria.conditional_pass: All four route subtests and applicable first-living/private-access requirements proven with valid same-model scenario/profile; successes are not transferable between routes or to overall programme.
fail_examples: Only usable dining connection passes through required kitchen work/use area.
Living path succeeds but dining destination is disconnected.
WC guest access necessarily cuts private sleeping domain under applicable requirement.
current_criteria.catalog_checker_limit: Attached bounded source-profile route study does not close first-living/scenario/ergonomic requirements; legacy whole-kitchen-floor exclusion is conservative, not equivalent to work-area rule.
current_criteria.next_action: Read same-model dd3b assessment after baseline integrity audit, distinguish each open rule/profile/evidence and add scoped witness without copying old-model probes.

current_criteria.rule: Living must be a genuinely continuous furnishable and usable floor, not a label, bounding box, narrow neck or leftover winding strip. Internal furniture use and width-bearing movement evidence remain necessary even when movable furniture is omitted from output. Compare long circulation with a genuinely shorter organisation under the same programme.
required_data: Exact non-overlapping actual living-floor union, excluded kitchen/dining/threshold/private circulation and accounting conventions.

Actual source-bound seating fixtures, activity targets, all required design persons, access/use and simultaneous-use scenarios. Access routes may traverse authorized circulation; circulation area does not thereby become useful living.

Separate witnesses: a claimed living-floor continuity path must remain in that explicitly defined floor scope; actual access paths use their valid floor/circulation domain. Record coherent furnishing/group use, route lengths/turns/bottlenecks and shorter alternative with rejection reasons.
Functional useful area distinguished from residual geometry, fixture footprints and released wall material; comparable denominators.
missing_profile: Reviewed quality anchors and necessary activity/room-floor thresholds remain incomplete.
missing_evidence: Same-model coherent group use and continuous functional floor, true useful-area accounting and shorter valid organisation comparison.
known_rule_scope: No universal golden ratio, corridor-length cap, waste percentage or arbitrary compactness threshold is authorized.
Living-floor continuity and real access routing have distinct domains. A source-labelled entry_circulation access path is not forbidden by this rule, nor counted automatically as useful living.
current_criteria.conditional_pass: Necessary furnishing, cohesive use, floor continuity and applicable quality/comparison requirements all proven for each unit under valid profiles; mere seat connectivity is insufficient.
fail_examples: A required furniture activity or access is demonstrably unusable.
A labelled living strip cannot support required programme under a valid profile.
current_criteria.catalog_checker_limit: Seat-access connectivity and route metrics are partial diagnostics, not continuous useful living or quality approval; overall ID remains UNKNOWN.
current_criteria.next_action: Read same-model dd3b assessment after baseline integrity audit, distinguish each open rule/profile/evidence and add scoped witness without copying old-model probes.

current_criteria.rule: Do not retain an added wall or L arm whose only function is hiding private views without bounding a genuinely usable space. Real bedroom/bath/closet boundaries may be functional, but names, one-ended attachment or a privacy PASS do not prove it. For each added wall record identity, geometry, function and removal/alternative effects; resolve privacy through real organisation rather than fictitious spaces.
required_data: Complete added-wall inventory and same-image IDs; exact source/placement/material aliases and geometry.
Real served space, usable fixture/activity evidence, clear widths and role beyond visibility masking.
Counterfactual removal or alternative positioning with unchanged programme and exact material-union differences (overlapping aliases preserved).
Fresh comparison of actual usable area, route length/access, furnishing and privacy; same-model provenance and dependent rechecks after changes.
Separate physical material released from proven functional useful-area gain; identify conceptual core scope and avoid blanket permission to remove structural/core walls.
missing_profile: Specific use/privacy scenario may need qualification; do not generalize one body-width study.
missing_evidence: Per-wall function/use and removal/alternative records; unchanged programme and exact alias-aware geometry; current dependent checks.
known_rule_scope: Qualitative ban and comparison duty already exist; no missing owner preference or fixed waste percentage should be invented.
current_criteria.conditional_pass: Every applicable added wall has genuine functional/use evidence and required same-programme comparison; no only-view screen or fictitious serving space remains, and dependent privacy/access/use requirements hold. No automatic closure from provenance alone.
fail_examples: Wall proven to serve only view masking with no real usable boundary.
Rename screen as hall/storage while keeping same nonfunctional geometry.
current_criteria.catalog_checker_limit: No complete per-wall alternative proof is installed; provenance, closure dependency or detached probes alone do not imply necessity/quality. ID remains UNKNOWN.
current_criteria.next_action: Read same-model dd3b assessment after baseline integrity audit, distinguish each open rule/profile/evidence and add scoped witness without copying old-model probes.

decision_semantics.PASS: Conditional future criterion-level result only when every applicable necessary subcondition has fresh same-model evidence, a valid scenario/profile and no mandatory correction; this catalog grants no PASS.
decision_semantics.FAIL: A demonstrated violation of a known necessary condition. Keep other unresolved findings; do not erase them because FAIL dominates.
decision_semantics.UNKNOWN: No demonstrated violation, but at least one necessary condition lacks effective profile, evidence, coverage or resolved interpretation.
decision_semantics.missing_rule: Required predicate or applicability genuinely unspecified; absence of checker is not missing rule.
decision_semantics.missing_profile: Qualitative rule exists, but effective scenario/anthropometric/operation/quality calibration is unqualified.
decision_semantics.missing_evidence: Predicate known but current model lacks valid measurement, route, use or counterfactual witness.
decision_semantics.delivery: FAIL and effective UNKNOWN block design-option display/count/delivery. Diagnostic evidence is not a design option. One criterion PASS never implies whole-model acceptance.
decision_semantics.excluded: NOT_EVALUATED_NOT_BLOCKING_MVP only for explicit POST_MVP predicate; not PASS.
decision_semantics.known_rule_missing_evidence: UNKNOWN criterion plus reason MISSING_EVIDENCE; NOT_RUN if evaluator was never executed. Neither equals missing rule.
decision_semantics.failure_and_errors: Proven necessary FAIL and unrelated evaluator error remain independent recorded reasons; neither erased.
